_comment_embedded: To enable vector search, set embedding-provider to 'openai' or 'ollama', supply MEMORY_EMBEDDING_URL (and MEMORY_OPENAI_API_KEY for OpenAI), and bump MEMORY_VECTOR_DIM to match your embedding model (e.g. 1536 for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small).
_comment_rebuild: Cargo rebuilds on every launch when invoked via 'cargo run'. For a faster cold start, replace 'cargo' with the absolute path to your release binary ('/path/to/memory-mcp') after 'cargo build --release', and drop the 'run --bin memory-mcp --' prefix from args.
_comment_dim: MEMORY_VECTOR_DIM defaults to 1024. It must equal the dimension of your embedding model AND match the dimension used when the database was first created — changing it after the DB exists will not migrate existing vectors.
